This plot is very small, only 0.06 hectares, and I grow something other than my main crops here — maybe some vegetables or a bit of chat for the household and market. Since it is intercropped and close to home, I put manure from my animals on it rather than buying expensive fertilizer, which the cooperative brings late anyway. I use seeds I saved from last year, and I do not spray chemicals. My daughters and I work this plot ourselves; I do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece.
